reference.code: const nums=s=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};exports.rankCompress=function(s){let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;let u=[...new Set(a)].sort((x,y)=>x-y),r=new Map(u.map((x,i)=>[x,i]));return a.map(x=>r.get(x)).join(',')}
